capabilities: Track semesters, classes, lectures, assignments, readings, exams, and study groups with statuses
Calculate grades from weighted assignments and exams, and track attendance against a minimum
Compute reading pace and writing word goals from linked notes
Generate syllabus notes and create linked lecture, assignment, and meeting notes from templates
Export the schedule as an .ics calendar file, CSV, and a JSON backup
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The JSON backup cannot be re-imported; it exists only so data is not in one place. Includes a grayscale/e-ink display mode and full mobile support.
motivation: The author, a self-learner, found that syllabi don't fit cleanly into task lists and built the tracker they personally needed, living inside the vault next to their notes.
problem: Obsidian's task lists and daily notes don't model coursework structure, so tracking lectures, deadlines, readings, and grades across classes becomes its own manual job.

relations.evidence: leaves everything else as written, including Templater code
course, lecture, date, and type properties (for use in Bases)
Import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

requires.name: calendar app (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook) for .ics import

summary: Academic tracker that organizes semesters, classes, lectures, assignments, readings, exams, grades, and study groups inside the vault.
